<!--
The orcid mark in the author note.

Every format but plain latex places the svg apaquarto ships. Quarto turns an
svg into a pdf by calling rsvg-convert, which it bundles on windows and on a
mac and not on linux, so apaquarto-latex-pdf stopped there -- "Could not
convert a SVG to a PDF for output" -- over a mark four millimetres wide. The
whole of example.qmd failed to build on a linux box for it.

apaquarto-pdf never hit this: apa7 draws the mark with addORCIDlink and asks
for no image. Plain latex now does the same thing with the orcidlink package,
which draws it in tex. So the .tex is checked for the command and for the
absence of the image, and the other formats are checked to be sure they still
place the file.
-->

# Method

A paragraph, so the document has a body.
